Session 13 Scene 4: The Frozen Causeway

Hub: @UUID[Compendium.pnp-end-game.pnp-endgame-journals.JournalEntry.7d4fa8464aee96dc]{session13 prep} · Assets: @UUID[Compendium.pnp-end-game.pnp-endgame-journals.JournalEntry.8e4f149331ff0974]{session13 asset checklist} Table time: 15 min · Foundry: module scene Rosehold 0 — The Thornwall (A2) 🔗 Castle note: @UUID[Compendium.pnp-end-game.pnp-endgame-journals.JournalEntry.cf5d4639928d11ad]{00 The Thornwall}, A2 · Tracker: @UUID[Compendium.pnp-end-game.pnp-endgame-journals.JournalEntry.168a20ce123acb41]{rosehold tracker}

The first step inside the Queen's reach. Start the Cold at 0 and tell the players it exists: "From here on, the castle notices noise and time. I'll keep a count. When it rises, bad things wake up." (Rules: @UUID[Compendium.pnp-end-game.pnp-endgame-journals.JournalEntry.fa6597afb86e582d]{rosehold runbook}, section 3.)

Entry

A spine of rock a wagon wide, glazed with ice, a long fall either side. The wind comes down it like something poured. Halfway along, two dead trees lean over the path with their roots in nothing.

Amy rides Aurelius behind the party. The allies wait at the foot of the causeway until the wall is broken.

The ice

  • Crossing at a walk is safe.

  • Running, fighting or riding calls for GRACE. A failure is a slide to the edge: d6, and hanging on until helped up (an Action for a friend).

  • Filly's Natural Climber gives advantage. Major Ursa is a polar bear: he does not slide, and anyone holding on to his fur has advantage too.

  • ⭐ Vega can Shape grit across the ice: no tests for anyone.

The two trees

They are @UUID[Compendium.pnp-end-game.pnp-endgame-actors.Actor.b948ef4b652142b5]{Awakened Trees}: ents of the low forest, marched up here and frozen angry. They let the party reach the middle, then close in from both ends.

Monster HP SAVE Armor Attack Special
@UUID[Compendium.pnp-end-game.pnp-endgame-actors.Actor.b948ef4b652142b5]{Awakened Tree} ×2 8 8 2 Twice: Bash (d6) Axes, hatchets and fire ignore Armor. 1 GD Tangle. Wounded = Rootbound Curse

⭐ Vega spotlight. He can speak to trees (Elemental Connection, and the Rosewood Crown if he wears it). If he asks what they want:

The trees, together, like a floor settling: "Down. Where it is green."

A GRACE test (his manners; advantage if he mentions the two ents he woke fifty years early in session 6), and they simply walk off down the mountain, past forty astonished princesses. That is a win and costs no dice.

If it comes to a fight: it is loud. +1 Cold (a loud fight in the open). Blitzenaxt ignores their Armor.

Exit

The wall is ahead: @UUID[Compendium.pnp-end-game.pnp-endgame-journals.JournalEntry.727b673bf45bc312]{The Barrier of Thorns}.

Scene assets

  • Background: Rosehold 0 — The Thornwall (module 0.7.0, already imported and staged in the world).

  • Tokens: PCs, Major Ursa, Amy and Aurelius. Two Awakened Tree tokens at the causeway's midpoint (monsters/assets/awakened tree.png).

  • GM only: @UUID[Compendium.pnp-end-game.pnp-endgame-journals.JournalEntry.168a20ce123acb41]{rosehold tracker} for the Cold.
